column1: # The ONNX Runtime the builds link, pinned by hash: version 1.31.0, the archives ort-sys 2.0.0-rc.15 itself selects

# Checked 24 Nov 2026: the newest ONNX Runtime is 1.32.0 (16-17 Nov; 1.31.1 on 26 Oct is a patch for an OpenVINO Python build and WASM tests, no effect here). It is not pinned: the newest ort crate is 2.0.0-rc.15 (19 Oct 2026, github.com/pykeio/ort), which selects 1.31.0 and has not been built against 1.32.0; a bump needs an ort release that selects it.
# (its build/download/dist.tsv). Per target, the first row is the build with no execution provider asked for: the
# plain build on Linux, DirectML on Windows, CoreML on Apple silicon. A ROCm build (praecise-onnx/rocm asks for
# MIGraphX) takes the migraphx row, a CUDA build (Dockerfile.cuda, Windows CUDA) its cuda13 row. Each archive is a
# raw LZMA2 tar of flat files:
# the static library, and the provider and DirectML libraries it loads at run time from the binary's folder.
# scripts/release/fetch-onnxruntime.py fetches one, refuses any other hash, and unpacks it to the directory
# ORT_LIB_LOCATION names. Intel macOS has no prebuilt runtime and loads one at run time. scripts/build-cuda-native.sh
# links a runtime the operator built for the host.
# The cuda13 CUDA provider carries SASS only (no PTX): aarch64 for sm_87, sm_90, sm_100, sm_110, sm_121; x86_64 for
# sm_75, sm_80 (also runs on sm_86 and sm_89), sm_90, sm_120. An x86_64 GPU of another architecture (B200, sm_100)
# has no CUDA provider from it. Both link TensorRT 10 (libnvinfer.so.10), cuDNN 9 and CUDA 13.
# Upstream (github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime) no longer exists, so there is no upstream release to hash: these are the
# archives ort-sys 2.0.0-rc.15 downloads, with the SHA-256 ort-sys itself pins, checked again here.
